title: Working with Chris Kelly's band and clarinetist Emile
summary: He worked with Chris Kelly's band without being a regular and says Emile was its clarinetist, never changed and never played saxophone.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. Do you say you worked with Chris Kelly's band? I was not a regular member of his band, but I worked with his band. Do you remember when Emil worked in his band?
Yeah. He was with him a long time, huh?
Yeah. Yeah. That was his regular climbing player. Yeah. Sometime I would work with him on the, with the Alphurs Sax. Yeah.
Has Emil's playing ever changed, do you think? Emil's playing. Has it ever changed or has it always been that way? It's always been that way. That's all. Yeah.
And he never did play saxophone. Never did. Mm-hm. No. You ever worked with buddy Petit? I worked with them on the, with the alto sax.
Has Emile's playing ever changed? Has it ever changed or has it always been that way?
It's always been that way, just he was more familiar with his horn when he was young.
That's all. And he never did play saxophone?
